source.prompt: Afro house song, about 3.5 minutes, 122 BPM, C minor. Warm, hypnotic, sunset-by-the-river mood, joyful but deep. Rich, soulful female lead vocal with layered call-and-response harmonies on the chorus. Marimba and kalimba melodic riffs, Rhodes electric piano chords, deep rolling sub bass, soft string pad. Four-on-the-floor kick with heavy hand percussion: congas, bongos, djembe, shaker, rimshot patterns, offbeat open hats, claps on 2 and 4. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, wide mix with a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[Intro]
Oh, oh, oh

[Verse]
Red dust rising where the river bends
Barefoot dancing with my oldest friends
The night is humming like a beating heart
Every rhythm pulls the dark apart

[Pre-Chorus]
Can you feel it calling, low and slow
Deeper than the water ever goes

[Chorus]
Lanterns on the river, lighting up the way
Hold me in the rhythm till the break of day
Every drum is singing, every fire glows
Lanterns on the river, take me where it flows

[Verse]
